20 February 2008

  • Fighter Armor, Mage Armor and Ranger Armor pages are back up with pics again.
  • There is a new link to the left called List of Equations this is a page from our Game Mechanics section. The section has some fairly detailed articles on how to calculate weapon Average Damage per Second for a variety of cases.
  • Our Weapons page has links to non-RB weapons tables classified by class and handedness. The lists are by no means complete and will be added to with the new patch, but there are several entries that will let you know what sort of weapons are out there.
--Spetsdod 22:02, 20 February 2008 (CET)

There indeed are some problems with the pictures whenever they are scaled smaller to fit the page. 7 February 2008

I've upgraded the wiki software to version 1.11.1 from 1.10.1, which includes most linked category's/unused templates (Thats for you Spets), sorry for the time TheTownstons.com was not accessable. --LegendRunner 22:20, 7 February 2008 (CET)

30 January 2008

Spets here!   First off, HAPPY NEW YEAR!   Second, it looks bad IMO when there it appears there is no recent update. It may have seemed quiet on the news front, but we HAVE been busy making changes and particularly additions to the Wiki. I may get my wee-wee shwacked by the bossman for doing this, but here goes:
  • as of today we are currently up to 151 Rainbow items, more if you count the ones with different types. (13 versions of phat bling for example). There is also new link on the left under Special that will take you directly to the Rainbow List.
  • A huge dent was made in our armor sections: Fighter Armor, Mage Armor and Ranger Armor so by all means check it out and fill in the blanks if you can. They are organized by "set" for the most part, so you can outfit your toon in the lastest matching styles.
  • The skill tables are now sortable and are currently undergoing updates to be in line with build 100, self-buffs section should be current. This section will probably get a rework when the summoning skills come next patch. As before, we could use some assistance filling in the values in the tables; upgrade costs, mana costs, damage etc. etc. If you can fill in any of the tables where you see "--" feel free to do so. Or, if you don't know how the tables work and are afraid of ruining the page, just post what you have in the discussion tab for the skill.
  • Special effort has been made to make every page have a category that will allow navigation back to the most likely page you came from. Hopefully, this will keep you from having to use your browser's back button.
That's all for now. Hope you like the recent changes.
--Spetsdod 05:51, 30 January 2008 (CET)


29 November

I am happy to announce that we now got an IRC chat for the wiki, where users can chat with eachother to talk about whatever you want!
You can access it by This link and by the link in the menu.
We also added a new welcome message when you Register which is placed in your User talk page, so that way its never empty =)!
Next to that I'd like to say that Gallicus helped me much to get the item section fuller, and it will get bigger for sure, thanks Gallicus!


21 November

It was a bit quiet in the News Section, but we're BACK! With almost 100 members, a mainpage visited over 10 thousand times and nearly hitting the 100.000 page views! We need all help we can get, so we would be happy with your contribution. We've also added Google Ads in the menu, on a spot that won't be very annoying, I think. More to come! (From now on the News section will be updated more frequently) EDIT: We now got one hundred members! --LegendRunner 15:33, 22 November 2007 (CET)


29 September

Added multiple quests, and will add loads more, with that I'd like to announce that we now have 50 members, click Here if you want to sign up yourself.


16 August 2007

Skill pages are getting added in now and will probably be done soon. We need information though! Most of the skill pages have tables that list what the skills do at each level, the gold needed to obtain them, and their mana cost at each level. Since the wiki was started so recently, I didn't take down this information as I went. If you can fill in any of the tables where you see "--" feel free to do so. Or, if you don't know how the tables work and are afraid of ruining the page, just post what you have in the discussion tab for the skill. Thanks, and I hope you are all enjoying the Wiki so far.
